lab_questions.title: Calculate Total Daily Sales
lab_questions.description:
A retail store records the value of every purchase made during the day. At the end of business hours, the store manager needs to calculate the total sales amount.

Your task is to read the number of transactions followed by the transaction values and calculate the total sales for the day.

Some transactions may represent refunds, which are recorded as negative values and should be included in the final total.
